task_definition.task_description: Please check whether I have any available coupons, then find and review alternative audio recommendations for the black Sony WH-1000XM5, also check what’s trending, pick the best option, reserve 1 silver Sony WH-1000XM5 if that’s the best match, and then confirm the order. After that, generate an invoice with the best discount for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 and send it to alice@company.com for PayPal payment, then check the status of my bedroom AC, scan for smart devices in the living room, restart the bedroom AC, and send me a high-priority app alert with the restart message.

user_input.query: Hi, I’m user_01. Please check whether I have any available coupons, then find and review alternative audio recommendations for the black Sony WH-1000XM5, product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and also see what’s trending. Based on that, pick the best option; if the best match is the Sony WH-1000XM5, please reserve 1 silver Sony WH-1000XM5 and confirm the order. After that, generate an invoice with the best discount for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using items [{ product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1 }], quantity 1, and send it to alice@company.com for PayPal payment using payment_gateway paypal and payment_method card. Then check the status of my bedroom AC with device_id ac_bedroom, scan for smart devices in the living_room area, restart ac_bedroom, and send me a high-priority app alert with the restart message.
